hidden_test_cmd: sh -c 'PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" exec python -m pytest -q -p no:subtests "$@"' sh tests/hidden
tests_may_change_note: A fix naturally adds cases to the existing SQLite DML tests (where INSERT OR REPLACE is covered), to the default dialect's tests, or to the write tests of the dialects that must report it.

replay.reference_note: the fix's whole diff, tests included
replay.hidden_tests_from: the fix's TestSQLite::test_update_or, without its check of the private arg name 'alternative', plus MySQL beside Postgres and Teradata

naive_patches.naive.patch: reads UPDATE OR in every dialect and always writes it back: Postgres, MySQL and Teradata get it silently (Teradata even drops it), nothing is reported
